description: This Java class implements a client for reporting API usage statistics in the Thingsboard platform. It manages statistics collection, batching, and sending via Kafka-like messaging, with scheduled reporting intervals.

classes.name: DefaultTbApiUsageReportClient
classes.description: Implements a client for reporting API usage statistics, managing data collection, batching, and scheduled reporting.

classes.name: ReportLevel
classes.description: Represents a reporting level identified by tenant and optionally customer IDs.

classes.name: ParentEntity
classes.description: Represents an entity with tenant and customer IDs, used as a parent reference for reporting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the reporting client, sets up scheduled reporting tasks.

methods.name: reportStats
methods.description: Aggregates and sends collected statistics, optionally as urgent reports.

methods.name: toMsgPack
methods.description: Partitions a list of usage stats messages into batches for transmission.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Public method to record usage data for a tenant, customer, and specific API key.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Overloaded method to record usage count for a tenant, customer, and API key.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Internal method to update statistics counters based on report level.
